summary: Users can reset their password using their registered email.

testability.reason: The main flow is stated, but reset-link expiry, reuse rules, and password policy are unspecified.

overall_risk.reason: Password reset controls access to user accounts.

risks.description: If reset tokens can be reused or remain valid indefinitely, an exposed link could allow unauthorized account access.
Email delivery failures could prevent users from recovering account access.

edge_cases: Multiple reset requests for the same account
Reset link reused after a successful reset
assumptions: The user already has a registered account.
An email containing a reset link is the intended recovery mechanism; this requires confirmation.
clarification_questions: Is recovery performed through an emailed link or another mechanism?
How long should a reset link remain valid?
Should a reset link be single-use, and should a new request invalidate earlier links?
What password policy must the new password satisfy?
What response should be shown for an unregistered email address?
What should happen when email delivery fails?

test_scenarios.title: Reset password using a registered email
test_scenarios.description: Request recovery for a registered account and complete the agreed recovery process.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: The user can set a new password and log in using it.

test_scenarios.title: Request reset using an unregistered email
test_scenarios.description: Submit an email address that is not associated with an account.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Requires clarification: verify the agreed response and account-enumeration protections.

test_scenarios.title: Use a reset link at its expiry boundary
test_scenarios.description: If link-based recovery is confirmed, attempt resets immediately before, at, and after the agreed expiry time.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Requires clarification: link acceptance follows the agreed expiry duration and boundary rule.

test_scenarios.title: Reuse a reset link
test_scenarios.description: If link-based recovery is confirmed, attempt to use the same link after a successful password reset.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Requires clarification: link reuse follows the agreed single-use policy.

test_scenarios.title: Recover from email delivery failure
test_scenarios.description: If email-based recovery is confirmed, simulate a delivery failure and attempt the agreed retry process.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: Requires clarification: the user receives the agreed failure guidance and can retry according to the recovery policy.

confidence.reason: The main intent is clear, but several security and recovery rules need confirmation. This is a qualitative assessment, not a measured probability.
